name: Immich
description: High-performance photo and video backup with iPhone and Android apps, face recognition, smart search and shared albums.
author: Immich Team

volumes.name: library
volumes.description: Photo and video library (Immich's upload location). Choose a drive with room for the whole camera roll.

volumes.name: postgres
volumes.description: Immich database. Keep it on a local disk: network shares (SMB/NFS) are not supported.

volumes.name: model-cache
volumes.description: Machine-learning model cache (safe to delete; re-downloaded on demand).

env.label: Database password (internal; generate a random alphanumeric value)

installNotes: DB_PASSWORD is internal to this install: generate a new random value with letters and digits only (A-Z, a-z, 0-9, at least 24 characters) and pass it as an install env value. Never reuse a fixed or example password. Map the library volume to the drive that should hold the photos; the database stays in Talome's app data on a local disk. The first account created at http://<server>:2283 becomes the admin.
